eventDescription.title: Event Description
eventDescription.content: At the HITCON booth, SITCON will bring you a "Challenge Quest" that combines technology, fun, and creativity! There are 6 challenges in total, from Git Leak and Crypto to Python Jail - each one is exciting!
eventDescription.login: Use Google account to login and participate
eventDescription.flag: Enter the correct Flag for each challenge to pass
eventDescription.rewards: Complete 2, 4, and 6 challenges to receive different level rewards

rewardDescription.title: Reward Information
rewardDescription.content: After successfully completing challenges, you can exchange for rewards at the SITCON booth! Limited quantities available, first come first served!
rewardDescription.limitNote: One reward per person, cannot be claimed multiple times
rewardDescription.step1: Go to SITCON booth and ask staff to scan the QR code on your profile page
rewardDescription.step2: After staff confirmation, you can collect your reward on site!

profile.minRequirementNote: * Must complete at least 2 challenges to get rewards!
profile.exchangeRulesDescription: Regardless of which level you achieve, you can only claim one reward! But achieving higher levels gives you more choices!
profile.level1Reward: Level 1: You can choose "Stickers" as your reward.
profile.level2Reward: Level 2: You can choose "Stickers" or "Keychains" as your reward (choose one).
profile.level3Reward: Level 3: You can choose "Stickers", "Keychains", or "Annual T-shirt" as your reward (choose one).
profile.qrCodeNote: * Return to the SITCON booth and show the QR Code to exchange for rewards

about.title: 📢 SITCON 2026
about.venue: @ Academia Sinica Humanities and Social Sciences Building
about.aboutDesc1: Students’ Information Technology Conference (SITCON) was initiated in 2012, organized by students for students, dedicated to information education and open source spirit.
about.aboutDesc2: We hope to inspire more students to enter the world of information, gather at the conference, exchange ideas, and practice the concept of 'learning by doing, teaching and learning together'.
about.cocDesc1: SITCON welcomes participants from all backgrounds and identities, and encourages diversity. To ensure everyone enjoys the event, all participants are required to read the conference
about.cocDesc2: , and help create a friendly environment together.
about.joinDesc1: SITCON is an open community. Many preparation matters are discussed publicly on the
about.joinDesc2: . If you are interested, feel free to subscribe and contribute your ideas. If you want to join next year's team, check out the recruitment page!
about.joinDesc3: If you want to learn more about SITCON's preparation and discussions, visit
about.joinDesc4: to see the progress of SITCON 2026.

recruitment.title:
SITCON 2026
Staff Recruitment Information
recruitment.subtitle: Welcome to join the organizing team! The table below includes deadlines, headcount, form links, and job details.

logistics.name: Logistics Team
duties: Food & Beverage: Ordering and delivery of meals
Mobile Support: Assist when other teams/sections are short-staffed
Registration: Ticket verification and item distribution at check-in
Logistics: Item flow between venue and warehouse
preferred: The Logistics Team is mainly responsible for venue-related matters during the annual conference. Only requires sufficient enthusiasm and judgment ability in emergency situations. It's the team with the lowest entry threshold and highest recruitment numbers for SITCON workers. Newcomers are very welcome!
notes: * Actual work content varies slightly by different sections

marketing.name: Marketing Team
duties: Assist with sponsor and media reception during the annual conference
preferred: Interest in marketing and business communication
Good at writing emails, enjoys communication and negotiation

design.name: Design Team
duties: Annual conference visual design, merchandise and other graphic design
Create animations and social media graphics
Work closely with logistics, development, and editorial teams on design requirements
preferred: Proficient in Illustrator / Figma / Photoshop and other design software

dev.name: Development Team
duties: Official website, CFP system, treasure hunt system development
Technologies used (examples): HTML / CSS / JS; May use: Astro, Fastify, Three.js, Figma
preferred: Familiar with Web development (not just using prompts, willing to understand the underlying logic)
Willing to invest time and energy to accomplish big things together

record.name: Documentation Team
duties: Photograph sessions, interactions, booths, etc. during the annual conference
Participate in training before the event, assist with photo editing and organization afterward
preferred: Understanding of composition and color grading
Proficiency in Lightroom / Photoshop or video editing software preferred
